integrity: The mathematical proof and finite reproducibility checks are provided; independent correctness and priority validation have not been performed. Earlier derivation of the secular equation and the known sufficient threshold are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite one-particle non-Hermitian tight-binding matrices with positive reciprocal directed hopping and a single real positive onsite impurity. The asymptotic impurity cutoff takes g to infinity at fixed N; the large-N statement concerns the resulting exact prefactors and is not a joint limit. The critical matrix need not be diagonalizable. No many-body or dissipative master-equation result is claimed.
title: Modulo-four spectral-realification thresholds in a nonreciprocal impurity ring
